reviews.title: Update… Ads crashing, falling, or freezing on iPhone now aswell
reviews.text: Update 9/13/26: Ads been better, not perfect, but much better. Fix was my end, needed to be done in my phone and my friends newer phone. The fix was to turn off targeted. That it. You can do it too, in some ads somewhere on the screen there’s a (blue?) triangle. Press it and it will give a slider to turn of targeted ads for this single app, not all, just this one and it’s per divine not per game save so if your playing on multiple iPhones then do this for all. Not sure about android, I mostly have up making my old one work with this game. Plus one star star but it wasn’t really earned, I just really like the story. The gameplays ok. Good luck. (Old): The makers are very good about compensating for mistakes. Two stars. These two part ads are causing the lions share of the problems, specifically moving from one add to the next. Not that the end of the 2nd ad doesn’t lead to a freeze sometimes (if you get that far). Update 07/17/26 (evening): I’m on my friends newer phone again, ads are just as messed up, what has happened to this game! At least bring ad skip down to 10$! I’ll buy it and this problem (there are others still) will be “fixed”! Update 07/17/26 (morning): After changes were made to fix ads it seams to have had no change. I got 10-15 ads in row just now that were black screens except for an X so I luckily didn’t need to restart. Update 07/09/26: Tried the game on a friends newer iPhone with a two part ad that wouldn’t move on to the next ad without freezing. The whole reason I got a newer device was because this game almost never worked on my oldAndroid tablet device. It used to work on my old device but then it stopped. Now on my newer device there are predictable and repeatable crashes.. AND NOW ads keep crashing (It doesn’t crash the game it just crashes the ad)/falling. On the same producible ads by the way. (Heres an example of inconsistency: 4 ads in a row for “Rouge Max”(how appropriate) hewing tobacco. First one was a double ad, worked flawless. Second ad was the same one but after clicking skip, it crashed the ad. Third was the tobacco ad but by itself, click close at the end and got my reward.Fourth and final ad was the double again, and like the second time, clicked skip to next ad and it crashed the ad). Freezing on certain predictable ads as well, freezing so I can’t exit the ad without killing the game manually. Do I need to get ANOTHER new NEW device! I’d get the ad skip but it’s so so expensive compared to pretty much any other game I played. Actually it IS more expensive than any game I’ve played, WHEN IT’S ON SALE! Been playing this game since almost halfway through its first year, if I didn’t enjoy the story so much I’d be long gone. I remain for Elly.

reviews.title: Genuinely fun
reviews.text: If you like incremental games where each run gets you a little stronger, you’ll probably love this. It’s simple in a refreshing way, easy to learn, and offers a variety of automation and literally thousands of levels of artifacts to continue growing stronger over long-term play. The main game loop has occasional minor variations to keep things fresh without over complicating the gameplay, several bosses of increasing difficulty with “hard mode” variants that you can unlock spawns for later for more of a challenge, and several different units and unit types to support longer-term goals as you work towards unlocking the best of the best and learning which classes you prefer. Did I mention that there are no mandatory ads? Oh yeah. No mandatory ads. You watch what you want, when you want. It’s not flawless, but it’s still an absolutely solid 5/5 for me.

reviews.title: Reduce the price

Overall good game with nice visuals, but the monetization tactics really detract from the experience.

reviews.title: Very Rarely Anything Wrong With This Game
reviews.text:
The only possible downside is the amount of money you need to spend for some items/accessibles can be a bit much. Asides from permanent ad removal, they're all only things to speed in game progress (the ad removal LITERALLY speeds up the game by not having to spend time watching them, the other items improve progression).

Immensely well made game that feels like genuine progress can be made in it, idling gets you results and it's fun to learn the game. Would very recommend!

reviews.title: To keeps things brief, it’s awesome.
reviews.text:
Love the game and have been playing for a good while now… Cool concept, and as far as idle games go, it’s pretty unique. Fight to progress till you can’t, and try again. Overall, I dare say it’s an idle souls like game …

Works well with those looking to idly play with your brain off or those wanting a bit of strategy into the mix. It’s viable and fun to see how far you get with certain, I’ll say, “builds”. 

Can totally play this free to play too! 

Though after a while, for this game I’ve deviated a bit, er well a lot, for the sake of convenience… yeah…

Asides from that, I’d say try it out for a couple of minutes and see if it’s for you.

Side note… Purchasable/unlockable skins for the your main character would be a nice addition. 

It’d be cool if I could be a reaper with a scythe and do a run with only necromancers(for the most part, hire luck and all) or same with the elves… etc. 

And maybe certain skins offer bonuses to you or you minions, or both. Or said bonuses can be random, alternating every run or something.
